Check a segmenter against the segmenter contract

Source: R/doc-read-check.R
gr_check_segmenter.Rd

Cuts the bundled example document (gr_example()) with one registered segmenter and reports which rules of the segmenter contract it breaks. Nothing is refused: a segmenter that fails a rule stays registered and runs as before. Use it on a segmenter of your own after gr_register_segmenter().

Usage

gr_check_segmenter(segmenter, client = NULL)

Arguments

segmenter

A registered segmenter's name; see gr_segmenters().

client

A gr_client to read with. NULL (the default) uses a gr_mock_client() whose reply to a request with a JSON schema is an object of that schema's shape, and a fixed sentence otherwise.

Value

An hr_conformance data frame; see hr_check_module().

Details

The spec is gr_segment_spec(method = segmenter, max_tokens = 150, context_source = "llm"), so contextual writes its context lines with the model. A client you pass is used whatever the segmenter declares, so calls_declared sees every call it makes with one. With none, a segmenter that needs a client, or declares calls, is given the offline one.

Rules

is_function, runs

The segmenter's fn is a function, and gr_segment() with it finishes without an error.

chunks_class

It returns a gr_chunks whose chunks is a data frame.

chunk_columns

chunks has the columns gr_chunks documents: chunk_id, text, tokens, chars, page, section and block_id.

chunk_text

Every chunk has text that is not blank.

chunk_ids

Chunk ids are unique and not NA.

within_cap

No chunk the segmenter returned was over max_tokens. gr_segment() splits an oversized chunk and records it in extra$cap_enforced, and the segmenter is reported for each one it had to split.

calls_declared

The label of every model call in the trace is covered by a stem the segmenter declared in calls, by the rule an effort map is checked with.

See also

hr_check_module(), gr_check_reader(), gr_register_segmenter()

Other segmentation functions: gr_chunk_stats(), gr_chunks, gr_register_segmenter(), gr_segment(), gr_segment_spec(), gr_segmenters(), new_chunks()

Examples

gr_check_segmenter("paragraph")
#> Using cached ingestion for this document + settings.
#> Segmenting with 'paragraph' (cap 150 tokens, overlap 0).
#> <hr_conformance> segmenter 'paragraph', contract 0.1
#>   passes all 8 rules
#>   ok    is_function
#>   ok    runs
#>   ok    chunks_class
#>   ok    chunk_columns
#>   ok    chunk_text
#>   ok    chunk_ids
#>   ok    within_cap
#>   ok    calls_declared: no model calls
